title: BUR to Brickell
body: Flew BUR–DEN–MIA and checked into AC Hotel Brickell. First night looking at the bay, palms, and the high-rises lighting up.

title: Dinner on the water
body: Crazy About You on Brickell Bay. Tostones first, then a slab of cheese with honey and pistachios, ribs under onion straws, seared fish. The paper liner on the table spelled the name so nobody could miss it.

title: Around the city
body: Waffles in the morning, then out. Freedom Tower against the glass boxes, Zaha Hadid’s One Thousand Museum, the wave sculpture at Maurice A. Ferré Park — dolphin, turtle, manatee in one curl. El Loro at Bayside, red pirate hull, skyline behind it. The Octopus Building on NW 36th, mosaic tentacles, no irony.

title: Calle Ocho
body: Little Havana on foot. Sugarcane through the press, guarapo in a foam cup. Domino Park — tables full, we stayed at the arch. Old’s Havana: mojitos with cane, a live band, palomilla with moros and maduros. Coffee at La Colada under Celia Cruz and a man-sized moka pot. A pressed Cuban at Sanguich on the way back, then pizza and burrata in Brickell Village like the afternoon needed a second act.

title: Down to Key West
body: Key West Express+ bus from Key Largo, top deck, Overseas Highway glare. Channel 2 Bridge at Islamorada, the old Seven Mile with trees growing on the deck, US 1 over water at Marathon. In town: Garrison Bight and the marlin sign, the Hard Rock gingerbread on Duval, Margaritaville salt-rim, The Wandering Rooster Citroën (and the rooster), The Red Doors from 1827, a pirate on the bench at Shipwreck Treasures. Back to Brickell that night.

title: On the Lady
body: Bayside in a squall, then a Hard Rock burger with a flag in the bun. Boarded Virgin Voyages Brilliant Lady at PortMiami — eleven nights, Southern Caribbean & Aruban Nights. Late afternoon sail-away.

title: Southbound
body: First full day at sea. The meals that stuck later: The Test Kitchen and Pink Agave.

title: Still water
body: Another sea day, still heading south. Aruba in the morning.

title: Around the island
body: Jeep from Oranjestad. South along the mangroves at Savaneta, a mural in San Nicolas, Baby Beach at the tip. Then the park: Fontein Cave, Boca Prins, a dirt track through Arikok, the natural pool on the north-east coast. California Lighthouse at the other end, Malmok boats, and Passions on the Beach at Eagle Beach — steak wrap, tuna, the water still doing the color it promised.

title: Toward Colombia
body: A sea day between Aruba and Cartagena.

title: City tour
body: Walled city. Castillo San Felipe from the ramp, Cartagena Cathedral, a Club Colombia in the heat. Lunch at La Cevicheria — the plate said the name. Siphon coffee at Café San Alberto like a lab. The Lady stayed overnight.

title: Last light in port
body: A second day in Cartagena. Afternoon departure.

title: North again
body: At sea, Jamaica next.

title: River and beach
body: Shore Thing. White River tubing — green tubes, blue vests, bamboo on the bank. Then Bamboo Beach Club, a turtle on the sign, shuttle back with the whole van accounted for. Brilliant Lady on the hook at the cruise pier.

title: In the water
body: Welcome to the Cayman Islands, coat of arms and all. Tender into George Town, the Lady sitting out on the water. Cayman Boat Adventures, mangroves, then in with a stingray on the sand in clear water. GoPro did the close pass.

title: Last night on the Lady
body: Sea day back toward Miami.

title: Off the Lady
body: Disembarked Brilliant Lady in Miami at first light.

title: One night ashore
body: Overnight at Travel Inn Riviera Beach, between ships.

title: On Paradise
body: Boarded Margaritaville at Sea Paradise at Port of Palm Beach — a three-night Nassau run.

title: A short hop
body: Sea day on Paradise, Palm Beach toward Nassau.

title: City tour
body: Bay Street first: Bahamas Rum Cake Factory, then Queen’s Staircase cut through the limestone with the Bahamian flag in the gorge. A red colonial house flying both flags. Tacos and a lime soda at John Watling’s Distillery. Ended in the water off West Bay Street — Nassau doing the color it advertised.

title: West to LAX
body: Off Paradise in Palm Beach. Trip’s end. Home to LAX.
